description: Handheld enclosure with two protected momentary buttons, a Heltec V4 board, removable retainers and an explicitly unselected LiPo reference envelope.
releaseRequirements: Confirm the exact Heltec revision, switch bezel dimensions, battery dimensions, connector polarity and cable envelopes on the delivered hardware.
